items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: that was AJ P-Rom eight piece dancer obviously ... myself playing the drums

ctx.x: Thursday yeah that was AJ P-Rom's dance orchestra and later all the years P-Rom braced his band up in fact he leave his band and went in to took the band band Hinojana Rania then was run by a fellow by the name was Sidney Kate playing banjo and guitar called it the Sunny South Sidney Montague on drums Sidney Kate and banjo and several other fellas I can't think of all of the names some is Wilfred on trumpet and some of Emil Fritz on saxophone that was the Sunny South obviously
did you tell us who else was in the P-Rom band when you were there I forget if you told us
